svg.title: A worker KILLed 60.1 and 300.1 s into the wave: the wave on attempt 2, 2 of 2 ADVANCE
svg.desc: A lane a gate of boot 4 through laug gate run -workflow, 3 items on cells; across, seconds from the gate's wave mark (timeline.jsonl). The upper bar is the wave, from its mark to its wave end mark; the diamonds above it are the items' ended marks, the ticks under it the lines of the gate's poll.jsonl. The row under it is this checkout's worker. G2 ran with one throughout. In G4 and G5 the batch sent KILL to the worker's process group, the solid line (readings.json's killed_at), and started another; the worker row's middle segment, no worker, runs up to the next one's Started Worker line, after it replayed the open gate (its step file). The words give the activities temporal workflow show recorded on an attempt over 1 (each gate's attempts file in the pack's extra/), the largest gap between poll lines, and handed on, the post mark less the start. Sources: docs/tables/fig-adopted.jsonl, docs/tables/gates.jsonl, docs/tables/readings-2026-10-24-boot4.jsonl.
